title: Tensor compatibility of derived pullback composition on K-flat representatives
statement: Let X,Y,Z be arbitrary schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X→Y and g:Y→Z. Fix the derived category localizations [def-pc-derived-category], derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback], and the canonical composition comparison c selected by [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Let P,N be K-flat cochain complexes of O_Z-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex]. For the normalized tensor comparisons tau of [lem-sc-mixed-hom-tensor-pullback-iso], Lf*(tau_g(QP,QN));tau_f(Lg*QP,Lg*QN);(c_(QP) tensor c_(QN)) equals c_(QP tensor QN);tau_(fg)(QP,QN). This is the composable-arrow triangle only, on localized K-flat inputs; there is no cartesian square, equality transport or inverse composition map.

source.place: Lemma 079U (lemma-pullback-tensor-product), Lemma 0D5S (lemma-derived-pullback-composition), and Remark 08HY (remark-base-change); the tensor triangle in the parent proof, expanded through ordinary adjunction units.

proof.text: Use the fixed tensorator canonical property to obtain the composite-arrow chain isomorphism phi, its degreewise normalization, and the direct coordinate equation.

Pullback preserves K-flatness of P. The shared counits at P,N and the localization tensor map on their composite-arrow pullbacks are invertible by the proved K-flat coordinate helpers of CanonicalPullbackTensorComparison. Postcompose both routes with their tensor counits and this model map; it can be cancelled.

The successive route has the ordinary normalized value by derivedPullback_tensor_successive_normalization, using only the degreewise formula for phi. Evaluate the defining leftDerivedLift equation of the chosen c at the total tensor complex to obtain its shared-counit factorization.

For the direct route, postcompose the existing composite-arrow tensorator coordinate equation with c at QP tensor QN. Naturality of c along mu_Z moves c to the total tensor complex. Its counit factorization identifies this value with the successive-route normalization. Associativity combines the equalities and cancellation proves the unchanged triangle.

theorem derivedPullbackComposition_tensor_kFlat
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (P N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (hN : N.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) :
    let c : ∀ {U V W : Scheme.{u}} (a : U ⟶ V) (b : V ⟶ W),
        derivedPullback b ⋙ derivedPullback a ≅ derivedPullback (a ≫ b) :=
      fun a b ↦ (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) a b
    (derivedPullback f).map ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso g).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)) ≫
      (mixedHomTensorPullbackIso f).hom.app
        ((derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P),
          (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)) ≫
      ((c f g).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⊗ₘ
        (c f g).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)) =
    (c f g).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≫
      (mixedHomTensorPullbackIso (f ≫ g)).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)
